links.outcome: Nurses' perceived preparedness and adequacy of AI training for AI adoption
links.effect: Only 7.8% considered health professionals adequately prepared and 7.2% reported adequate AI training; 18.0% used AI products/services in daily life; longer experience was negatively associated with readiness.
links.quote: Perceived professional impact of AI was moderate, whereas readiness for AI adoption was comparatively lower, with only 7.8% considering health professionals adequately prepared and 7.2% reporting adequate AI training.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of nurses assessing readiness and digital skills for AI adoption, but not evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
